title: Cipher and Extraction
author: Oscar Eriksen
blurb: Felix Reyes, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
